entities.name: Customer / shipper
entities.description: The business or individual account that books shipments and orders.

provenance.notes: Both platforms scope records to an owning account (karrio OwnedEntity, fleetbase company_uuid).

entities.name: Order
entities.description: A customer's request to move goods; may be fulfilled by one or more shipments, or dispatched directly as a delivery job.

relationships.note: karrio: an order can spawn shipments

provenance.notes: karrio.Order has OrderStatus (unfulfilled/cancelled/fulfilled/delivered/partial); fleetbase_orders has dispatched/started boolean flags plus a free-text status column (exact values not enumerated in the schema). States list merges both, some values reasoned.

entities.name: Shipment
entities.description: A booked movement with a single carrier: parcels, addresses, selected rate, label, and status.

relationships.note: embedded customs data, international shipments only

provenance.notes: Verbatim from karrio's Shipment model and core.serializers.ShipmentStatus; single source.

entities.name: Parcel
entities.description: A physical package within a shipment: dimensions, weight, and packed commodities.

provenance.notes: karrio's Parcel model is the direct implementation. GS1 General Specifications' SSCC/GTIN and EPCIS's 'what' dimension (epcList/quantityList) authoritatively model the same physical-object concept; the states list is drawn from CBV business steps. Authoritative source present.

standard_mapping.concept: CBV business steps: receiving, storing, picking, packing, staging_outbound, shipping
standard_mapping.note: Verbatim CBV bizStep values (JSON-LD-Context/cbv-context-bizstep.jsonld), used here as the state vocabulary for a parcel's warehouse-to-carrier lifecycle.

entities.name: Commodity / line item
entities.description: A product line inside a parcel or order, with declared value and customs classification.

provenance.notes: karrio's Commodity and Product models; single source.

entities.name: Shipping label
entities.description: The generated carrier label document (and optional commercial invoice) for a purchased shipment.

provenance.notes: karrio Shipment.label/label_type/invoice fields; single source.

entities.name: Carrier
entities.description: A shipping carrier account connected to the platform, snapshotted onto each shipment at booking time.

provenance.notes: Observed as an embedded JSON snapshot (keyed by carrier_code) on karrio's Shipment model; the standalone carrier/connection model was not cloned. Single source.

entities.name: Carrier service level
entities.description: A specific rate/service tier offered by a carrier (e.g. ground, express).

provenance.notes: karrio's Shipment.services/selected_rate fields and fleetbase's fleetbase_service_rates table both model a named service level with pricing.

entities.name: Rate quote
entities.description: A price/transit-time quote returned by a carrier for a given shipment.

provenance.notes: karrio's Shipment.rates (list of quotes)/selected_rate and fleetbase's fleetbase_purchase_rates/fleetbase_service_quotes tables both model this.

entities.name: Manifest
entities.description: A grouping of shipments (carrier close-out) or stops (driver route manifest) for a single hand-off.

provenance.notes: karrio's Manifest model (carrier close-out) and fleetbase_manifests (driver route manifest) are independent implementations of related but distinct concepts. GS1's SSCC/GS1-128 standard is the authoritative identifier standard for a grouped 'logistic unit' hand-off, corroborating the general concept. States list is reasoned from fleetbase's started_at/completed_at columns.

entities.name: Pickup
entities.description: A scheduled carrier or driver pickup for one or more shipments.

provenance.notes: Verbatim from karrio's Pickup model and PickupStatus enum; single source.

entities.name: Tracking event
entities.description: A single append-only status/scan event in a shipment's or parcel's tracking timeline.

standard_mapping.concept: EPCIS event (what/when/where/why), corroborated by CBV business steps shipping/receiving/transporting/holding
standard_mapping.note: Verified against a local copy of GS1 EPCIS 2.0 / CBV 2.0 (Ontology/EPCIS.jsonld, JSON-LD-Context/cbv-context-bizstep.jsonld); no longer a name-only reference.

provenance.notes: karrio's TrackerStatus enum and fleetbase's fleetbase_tracking_statuses table are independent implementations. GS1 EPCIS 2.0 is the authoritative supply-chain event-visibility standard for exactly this concept. Authoritative source present.

entities.name: Proof of delivery
entities.description: The photo and/or signature captured at delivery, attached to the shipment or order.

provenance.notes: karrio's TrackingStatus.delivery_image_url/signature_image_url and fleetbase's payloads.pod_method/pod_required columns both model this.

entities.name: Dispatch assignment
entities.description: The record of assigning a driver and vehicle to an order, capturing when and how it was dispatched.

provenance.notes: Modeled as columns directly on fleetbase_orders (dispatched, dispatched_at, adhoc, driver_assigned_uuid, vehicle_assigned_uuid, is_route_optimized) rather than a separate table; single source.

entities.name: Route
entities.description: The sequenced set of stops (waypoints) planned for an order or manifest, with distance/time totals.

provenance.notes: fleetbase_routes table; single source.

entities.name: Waypoint
entities.description: A single stop (pickup, dropoff, or return) within a route or payload, with its own time window and service time.

provenance.notes: fleetbase_waypoints table; single source.

entities.name: Place
entities.description: A reusable, geocoded address used as a pickup, dropoff, or facility location.

provenance.notes: fleetbase_places table; single source.

entities.name: Driver
entities.description: A person who operates a vehicle to complete deliveries or pickups.

provenance.notes: fleetbase_drivers table is the direct implementation; traccar's Driver model (name, uniqueId) is a second, independent but thin implementation read via `gh api` without cloning. States list reasoned from fleetbase's online/current_status columns, exact string values not enumerated in either schema.

entities.name: Vehicle
entities.description: A fleet vehicle: specifications, capacity, and current telemetry.

provenance.notes: fleetbase_vehicles table and traccar's Device+Position models (odometer, engine hours, fuel, battery, GPS position; read via `gh api` without cloning) are independent implementations of vehicle/telemetry data.

entities.name: Fleet
entities.description: A named group of vehicles and drivers, optionally scoped to a service area or zone.

provenance.notes: fleetbase_fleets, fleetbase_fleet_drivers, fleetbase_fleet_vehicles tables; single source.

entities.name: Warehouse / location
entities.description: A physical facility where inventory is stored or shipments are consolidated.

relationships.note: parcels received, stored, and staged at this facility
shipments consolidated or originating from this facility
optional; a facility may be scoped to a service area

standard_mapping.concept: bizLocation / readPoint identified by a GLN (Global Location Number)
standard_mapping.note: GLN itself is defined by GS1 General Specifications (gs1-general-specifications); EPCIS references GLN-identified locations as the where dimension of an event, now verified against a local copy of both.

provenance.notes: Neither cloned implementation (karrio, fleetbase) models a warehouse as a first-class entity, so this stays standards-only. GS1 EPCIS's bizLocation/readPoint fields and CBV business steps (receiving, storing, staging_outbound, stocking) model warehouse-type facilities as event context, and GS1 General Specifications defines the GLN used to identify them; both are now verified on disk rather than name-only references.

entities.name: Delivery exception
entities.description: A flagged problem with an order, shipment, driver, or vehicle requiring investigation (damage, delay, failed attempt, safety issue).

provenance.notes: fleetbase_issues table is the direct implementation; karrio's needs_attention/delivery_failed ShipmentStatus values corroborate from a second implementation. GS1 CBV's disposition vocabulary (damaged, destroyed, returned, recalled, stolen, non_conformant, etc., verified on disk) is the authoritative standard vocabulary for exactly these exception/return states. Authoritative source present.

entities.name: Return shipment
entities.description: A shipment created to send goods back to the origin or a returns facility.

provenance.notes: karrio's Shipment.is_return/return_shipment/return_address fields and fleetbase's payloads.return_uuid/return_tracking_number_uuid both model this.

entities.name: Customs document
entities.description: The customs declaration data attached to an international shipment.

provenance.notes: karrio's Shipment.customs embedded field is the direct implementation. The WCO Data Model is the authoritative harmonized data model for customs declarations, and Incoterms 2020 standardizes the responsibility-transfer data a declaration depends on. States are reasoned typical customs terminology, not a literal enum from either standard. Authoritative source present; not a claim of customs compliance.

entities.name: Zone / service area
entities.description: A named geographic boundary used for pricing eligibility, routing, or geofence entry-exit events.

provenance.notes: fleetbase_zones and fleetbase_service_areas tables; single source.

entities.name: Maintenance record
entities.description: A scheduled or completed maintenance service event for a vehicle.

provenance.notes: fleetbase_maintenance_schedules and fleetbase_maintenances tables; states list reasoned from next_due_date/last_service_date columns. Single source.
